content_sections.heading: DHS Nagapattinam Salary
content_sections.text: Salary is paid per month and varies by post. The lowest salary listed is Rs. 11,000 for Multi Purpose Hospital Worker, and the highest is Rs. 44,000 for Micro Biologist. content_sections.heading: DHS Nagapattinam Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are entirely temporary. Appointees will not be made permanent at any time. Candidates must submit a self-willingness undertaking letter for joining the service. The number of posts is subject to change.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHS Nagapattinam Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification describes only offline submission. No online application link, application form format or list of enclosures is provided. Check the qualification and age limit for the post you want. Prepare your application along with the undertaking letter stating your willingness to join the service. Submit the application in person, or send it by Speed Post, to the address below. Make sure the application reaches the office on or before 09-10-2026, 5:45 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the District Health Society Nagapattinam (DHS Nagapattinam) for various healthcare and administrative positions across different schemes.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DHS Nagapattinam Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 44 vacancies available across multiple posts including pharmacists, medical officers, health inspectors, counselors, and support staff.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of filled offline applications is 09 October 2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for DHS Nagapattinam jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Interested candidates need to download the form, fill it out, and send it via post or submit it directly.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The monthly salary ranges from Rs. 11,000/- to Rs. 44,000/- depending on the specific post and qualification requirements.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum qualification required to apply?
faq.answer: Qualifications range widely based on the post, starting from 8th Pass for Multi Purpose Hospital Worker up to MBBS, Master's degrees, and specialized professional diplomas.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DHS Nagapattinam Recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the categories applying for these posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process for the candidates applying through this notification will be strictly based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted either directly or through speed post to the Executive Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, District Health Office, Nagapattinam district.

faq.question: Q10. What is the age limit to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit varies by post, ranging up to 59 years for specific positions like medical officers and dispensers.
